result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor content truncation issue.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is partially cut off on the right edge, with both the image and the restaurant name truncated mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container provides a visible affordance (e.g., partial card peek) that is intentional, or adjust card sizing and padding so partial cards are more clearly indicating scrollability. The restaurant name should not be cut off mid-word without an ellipsis.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off without an ellipsis, making it unclear what the full name is.
issues.suggestion: Apply text overflow ellipsis styling to truncated restaurant names so users understand the text is intentionally shortened.
